{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient, as required by the population definition
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of unique patients after deduplication
print(f'Unique patients after deduplication: {df_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check the distribution of severity in the deduplicated data
print('\nSeverity distribution after deduplication:')
print(df_dedup["severity"].value_counts().sort_index())"}
